text:
Maya Patel: Uploaded a quick screencap of the Privacy panel — noticed a couple of small but annoying things with the encryption badge and the audit filter copy. Samir Khan: saw it, can you point to the exact spots? Maya Patel: top-right of the dataset card — the lock pill reads 'Encrypted' but the tooltip says 'Managed by Redwood KMS' which is misleading for customers using BYOK. Also the pill contrast is pretty low on hover. Olivia Reed: agree on the wording. Maybe 'Encrypted — customer-managed key' vs 'Redwood-managed key' ? shorter variant for the pill though. Sophie Chen: Accessibility note: the pill loses visible focus when you tab into the card. Keyboard users can't tell it's selected. We should add an outline and ensure focus order: pill should be reachable before the card actions. :keyboard: Alex Gómez: +1 on focus order. Also the region dropdown in the panel defaults to alphabetical list; we discussed earlier it should surface the user's preferred region first (cookie/local pref) and then fallback to latency-sorted list. Is that captured in the mock? Maya Patel: mock currently shows alphabetical. I can update. For the audit log filters: the placeholder says 'search events...' but the microcopy doesn't explain what is searchable (key IDs? user emails?). Leads to random support asks. Samir Khan: we should be explicit. Suggestion: placeholder -> 'Search by event type, user email, or key ID'. Short and actionable. Olivia Reed: also the filter chips read 'KMS: any' which is weird. Maybe 'Key provider: any' or 'Key owner: any'. 'KMS' is internal jargon for some customers. Sophie Chen: sigh, yep. Also aria for the retention slider: when value is updated via keyboard arrows, the live region announces only the number, not the unit. Screen reader reads '30' instead of '30 days'. We need aria-live="polite" text like 'Retention: 30 days'. Maya Patel: here's a quick snippet I tested that fixes the live region (feel free to adapt): ```
Retention: 30 days
``` Alex Gómez: small UX nit: the modal CTA says 'Enable encryption' but toggles both encryption and key binding. Customers expect 'Enable encryption' to be passive if they already have a key. Could split to 'Bind key & enable' vs 'Enable (Redwood-managed)'. Samir Khan: backend-wise we can keep a single API but front-end should present the two flows differently. Add a small explanatory line under CTA. Keeps product safe. Olivia Reed: copy option A for the explanatory line: 'Choose a key from your account or let Redwood manage one for you. This action will encrypt stored artifacts.' Too long? Maya Patel: Maybe shorten: 'Choose your key or use Redwood-managed. Encrypts stored artifacts.' Still thinking. Sophie Chen: For contrast: the badge hover state needs >= 4.5:1. I ran it through Axe; current is 3.2. Can we darken the text by 18% and keep the pill background the same? Alex Gómez: I'll prototype the color change and show numbers. design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://app.fig.link/rs/privacy-panel-v4 — includes region-pref, clarified audit placeholders, split CTAs, and focus ring tweaks. Maya Patel: perfect — can folks glance this afternoon? aiming to ship with the next console patch. Samir Khan: I can review after 3pm PT. Olivia Reed: I'll do copy pass and accessibility check before EOD. Sophie Chen: will run Axe and keyboard walkthrough tomorrow AM. Alex Gómez: will add color numbers and a regression test for pill contrast. Maya Patel: thanks everyone! tagging product review board doc after we merge. :sparkles:
